text:
Taylor: new user report: sample throws at deploy time on Edge: "Cannot find module 'redwood-js-sdk'". Local node runs fine.
June: that's usually a resolution problem between CJS and ESM. Which fields do we ship in package.json?
Taylor: main -> dist/cjs/index.cjs, module -> dist/esm/index.mjs, types -> dist/types/index.d.ts. No exports field.
Marc: without an exports map some bundlers pick main, which is CJS, and ESM-only edge runtimes break. We need a clear conditional exports plus an explicit edge subpath.
June: recommended minimal exports snippet I use: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" },
  "./edge": "./dist/esm/edge-entry.mjs"
}
```
Taylor: good. Also saw auth token refresh failing on edge. Traced to retry logic: the ESM bundle used setImmediate and duplicated the retry code, so it never retried on Workers.
Marc: that's the classic dual-build drift. Fix by factoring auth into a single isomorphic module (src/auth/core.ts) and make both bundles import it instead of inlining. Avoid setImmediate; use a small timing util: globalThis.setImmediate ?? ((fn)=>setTimeout(fn,0)).
June: for onboarding short-term we should patch the sample to detect edge and import the edge shim path: 
```js
const isEdge = typeof globalThis?.fetch === 'function' && process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge';
const sdk = await import(isEdge ? 'redwood-js-sdk/edge' : 'redwood-js-sdk');
```
Taylor: I'll land the sample change + README note. Marc, can you take the package.json/exports and auth-core work?
Marc: yes. Build change: switch bundler to externalize auth/core so outputs reference the same file; add a dts rollup so types don't point to CJS internals. Keep top-level "types" key for TS.
June: also add a CI smoke job that runs the sample under a lightweight edge runner (wrangler dev or vercel dev) on PRs so these regressions fail fast. Add pnpm/yarn/npm matrix because resolution differs across package managers.
OpsBot: queued job devex/edge-smoke/sample-runner.
Taylor: quick todo summary: 1) sample runtime import guard (I'll PR), 2) exports + edge-entry (Marc), 3) auth/core externalization + typings (Marc), 4) CI smoke + package manager matrix (June).
Marc: one more lint idea: fail CI if an ESM entry imports node: builtins (node:fs, node:crypto). That would've caught the earlier crypto-in-edge crash.
June: agreed. Let's keep the edge shim deliberately tiny: fetch wrapper + auth core import. No node-only deps.
Taylor: thanks all  should make onboarding less surprising for edge users. Ping if anyone needs help reviewing PRs. :rocket:
